lines: This plan covers 7 days, starting Saturday 2026-09-12.
You cook on Sunday: the plan sets its sessions on those days, and nowhere else.
The plan starts on Saturday, a day earlier: that is the cooking day, and nothing is eaten on it.
Everything is cooked on Saturday, in one go: whatever would not keep in the fridge until the meal goes in the freezer.
One shop, on Saturday: everything this plan asks for keeps until it is cooked.
The Saturday session will take 3 hours 50 min rather than 2 hours: it is your only cooking day, and cooking less would leave days empty.
To stay inside it, expensive proteins give first, then out-of-season produce, then variety — never the portions.
The single Saturday session means later meals use frozen portions, so the plan keeps variety through different bowls, salads and toppings rather than adding another cooking day.
Cooked salmon is used on Sunday and the spare portion is frozen on Saturday, making the requested oily fish workable within the storage limits.
Tinned tuna replaces another cooked fish batch at the end of the stretch because it is cheaper and needs no extra session while still anchoring both meals with protein.
